planning_notes: Uno hardware pin D2 is used as a button input; serial output reports the counter value over Serial at 9600 baud.

Direction/active level behavior is normalized in SysML: this request models the button as true while pressed (active_high=true semantics in the model). If the physical wiring is different, SysML must handle the inversion, but no electrical inversion is introduced in this interface request.
A time delta input is required by the behavior; elapsed_ms is provided as program-owned delta since previous control step (first delta is zero).
Serial framing is assumed to follow the provided setting: line_or_idle with idle_timeout_ms=20.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Button on D2; each press increments counter by 1

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Actual delta since previous control step

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Business report condition: after each valid button press increment, report the current counter value
